decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of size, position, design and scale is considered to be unacceptable. The proposed depth of the extension is excessive and would be disproportionate to the original dwelling. The extension would be beyond the general rear building line on the street and would significantly exceed the guidance provided in the Residential Extension Guidelines. Accordingly, the proposal would fail to preserve or enhance the character of the Wellesley Road Conservation Area. The proposed development is contrary to Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of size, position, design and scale is considered to be unacceptable. The proposal would result in a loss of open outlook from the neighbouring properties, due to the excessive depth of the extension proposed. The proposed development is contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house.
